source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: updateAuth saves the username, awaits notifyVerification on error, completed and waiting branches, then closes ask-auth by that saved name. closeAuth also takes a username rather than a Context, and closeAskAuthNotification returns early for a missing name. Keep this ordering and primitive identity boundary when changing authentication UI. A null-pointer check on individual Context getters is a separate safety measure.
title: Await OTR notification changes before closing the ask-auth prompt
